atomization_evidence.scope: One eligible16m approach tile replaced with existing paired straight; correction confined to next16m tile; every later original routepoint preserved. Mirror-reversed opposing junction correction preserves complete direct-slip symmetry.

physical_rejection.decision: Retain: the real500mm branch-platform wing and open parapet continue into the neighbouring one-way curve. An ordinary straight restores a wall within1.17m of the branchPATH, inside its2.6m clearancehalfwidth; simple trimming does not preserve the physical connection.

atomization_evidence.surface_context_partition: The one revised collar tile uses the revised sweep; every other retained tile uses its literal unchanged analytic context. Both compile independently with disjoint output cells and one support owner per tile.

retained_surface_context.purpose: Literal unchanged sweep context for this current type’s retained tiles. Its remote curve miters and texture phase preserve exact existing models; only the explicitly listed collar tile uses the revised context.

angle_redesign.purpose: Record the authorized junction-angle redesign; these software measurements do not establish game operation.
angle_redesign.preservation: Both pieces retain their own mainline and southern direct-slip surface decks; the opposing merge retains its original revised-versus-retained compilation contexts.

west_straight_extraction.purpose: Retain the original four eastern cells and exact route fragments after replacing the western cell with the existing paired straight. The new west parapet collar is the only retained-surface correction.

native_west_parapet_collar.scope: Only the upper northern parapet and adjacent bed within east [-8, -5.5] m and north [5, 7.5] m are displaced, by at most 3.4524 mm. Every intersecting face is split at the continuous piecewise-affine warp's region boundaries, with exact clipping and all tiny triangle fans retained. Rails, the outer rim, the slab underside, the pier, and every other retained model remain unchanged. Existing vertex UV attributes are retained, and new cut attributes are interpolated; the spatial UV field inside the deformed collar can change.

opposed_parapet_alignment.purpose: Preserve both accepted continuous inner banks and join the separate outer strips in X0 and X3 along their own native branch inside outlines into the retained curved wings; retain all tracks, floors, supports, PATHs, and prior collar behavior.
